snippet.title: Stick Infinite Kingdom - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018078/

Protect the Kingdom of Kumariya in Stick Infinite Kingdom, an epic strategy-action game for PlayStation 5. Command legendary heroes, lead diverse factions, and experience massive real-time battles. Master tactical unit deployment and forge a path to victory in this deep, lore-driven campaign. Wishlist it now on the PlayStation Store!
